st: The Silk Road has never been so rough

sec.p: The magic 80%. As with so many distributions (hello again, Pareto), China controls 80% of solar panel production and of lithium extraction/refining. Europe, at least, is improving.

sec.t: ff.42.2 Polluting, or pushing the transition?
sec.p: Until a few years ago, China was synonymous with smog-choked cities. With the data on electric mobility and renewable energy, this bad reputation seems to have improved a little.

sec.t: ff.42.3 A spanner in the AI works
sec.p: Supremacy in electrification suggests an all-Chinese future. But on topics like artificial intelligence the situation is a bit different:
All these reflections raise a question: are we facing a new global order? Ray Dalio (already quoted in 📈 ff.14.2 Nostradamus: Ray Dalio and the world order) thinks so.
